lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: distinguishing similarity from congruence

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has ∠A = 31° and ∠B = 119°. Triangle DEF has ∠D = 31° and ∠E = 119°. Are the triangles similar, and on what grounds?
choices: Yes, by SSS similarity.
Yes, by AA similarity: two pairs of congruent angles force the third pair to be congruent as well.
Yes, but only if a pair of corresponding sides is also known to be congruent.
No; angle information alone never establishes similarity.

items.prompt: Under a dilation, a segment not through the centre, under a dilation with scale factor k …
choices: is mapped to a parallel segment k times as long
is mapped to a perpendicular segment k times as long
is mapped to a segment of the same length
is mapped to a segment k² times as long

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Dilate the point (3, 5) about the origin with scale factor 2. Give the image.
A figure is dilated so that a side of length 23 becomes a side of length 115. What is the scale factor, and what happens to the figure's area?
choices: scale factor 5; the area is multiplied by 5
scale factor 1/5; the area is multiplied by 25
scale factor 92; the area is multiplied by 25
scale factor 5; the area is multiplied by 25

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has ∠A = 37° and ∠B = 65°. Triangle DEF has ∠D = 37° and ∠E = 65°. Are the triangles similar, and on what grounds?
choices: No; angle information alone never establishes similarity.
Yes, but only if a pair of corresponding sides is also known to be congruent.
Yes, by SSS similarity.
Yes, by AA similarity: two pairs of congruent angles force the third pair to be congruent as well.

items.prompt: Under a dilation, a line that does not pass through the centre of dilation …
choices: is mapped to a perpendicular line
is mapped to a line with slope multiplied by the scale factor
is mapped onto itself
is mapped to a parallel line

items.prompt: Dilate the point (4, 6) about the origin with scale factor 4. Give the image.
A figure is dilated so that a side of length 8 becomes a side of length 24. What is the scale factor, and what happens to the figure's area?
choices: scale factor 1/3; the area is multiplied by 9
scale factor 3; the area is multiplied by 9
scale factor 3; the area is multiplied by 3
scale factor 16; the area is multiplied by 9

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has ∠A = 42° and ∠B = 38°. Triangle DEF has ∠D = 42° and ∠E = 38°. Are the triangles similar, and on what grounds?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
